<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="scavenging-farming" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Scavenging Farming</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Note: a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Table of Contents</nowiki></strong><nowiki> can be found in the pins.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Scavenging </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1" alt="scavenging" title="scavenging" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is an </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk which provides players a chance to get </nowiki><strong><nowiki>uncommon</nowiki></strong><nowiki> or </nowiki><strong><nowiki>rare</nowiki></strong><nowiki> components </nowiki><em><nowiki>as a drop</nowiki></em><nowiki>, whenever they kill an NPC.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each rank provides a 1% chance per rank for uncommon components to drop from a kill, with a 1% chance that they will be rare components instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scavenging 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1" alt="scavenging4" title="scavenging4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on level 20 equipment provides a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>4.4%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> chance per kill, of activation, with a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> chance that the components will be </nowiki><strong><nowiki>rare</nowiki></strong><nowiki> instead of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>uncommon</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Check the wiki for more information about </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Scavenging <nowiki>Scavenging</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1" alt="scavenging" title="scavenging" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Killing monsters en masse for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1" alt="scavenging" title="scavenging" kind="icon" /><nowiki> procs is called </nowiki><strong><nowiki>scav farming</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, a low effort/AFK way to obtain a variety of components.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="acquiring-scavenging-4"><ins><nowiki>Acquiring Scavenging 4</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ With Ancient Invention unlocked, scavenging 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1" alt="scavenging4" title="scavenging4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be obtained by placing 9 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604724224008.png?v=1" alt="preciouscomp" title="preciouscomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> into an </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1" alt="ancientarmourgizmo" title="ancientarmourgizmo" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prepare a few gizmos as the chance for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1" alt="scavenging4" title="scavenging4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is </nowiki><code><nowiki>1/15.4 at 137 Invention</nowiki></code><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Visit the wiki's </nowiki>[https://tinyurl.com/bdfskkd9 <nowiki>perk calculator</nowiki>]<nowiki> to calculate your chances at lower </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> levels.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure you use an </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540072169439242.png?v=1" alt="extremeinventionpotion" title="extremeinventionpotion" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="components"><ins><nowiki>Components</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Components obtained from scav farming are not only useful for making perks, but also crafting items which are profitable, including but not limited to:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>

    • Allows for automatic looting of noted bones in conjunction with the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1" alt="bonecrusher" title="bonecrusher" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Smoke_devil <nowiki>Smoke devil</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109432590865281126.png?v=1" alt="smokedevil" title="smokedevil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Smoke_Devil_scroll_(Dust_Cloud) <nowiki>Dust Cloud scrolls</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109432587086200953.png?v=1" alt="dustcloud" title="dustcloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405301623619624.png?v=1" alt="spiritcape" title="spiritcape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> allows your familiar to use its special move more often
    • Ensure familiar combat mode is default, and the autofire rate is set to 1
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="where-to-use-scavenging"><ins><nowiki>Where to use Scavenging</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Besides dedicated farming via </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1" alt="scavenging" title="scavenging" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (method below), it's a convenient perk to have for passive profit when engaging in any activity which requires killing large amounts of enemies. Consider bringing an armour piece with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1" alt="scavenging4" title="scavenging4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if doing:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Slayer creatures - Check out </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rs3-slayer</nowiki></span><nowiki> for details on methods. Examples include:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Nightmares - Popular AFK moneymaker, doable on and off-task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Vyres - Popular combat method for training </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213693790519307.png?v=1" alt="farming" title="farming" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Abyssal beast - Popular combat method for AFK gp and clues.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Champion scroll farming.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430543321071626.png?v=1" alt="seiryu" title="seiryu" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542326759435.png?v=1" alt="bsd" title="bsd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542809235458.png?v=1" alt="ambassador" title="ambassador" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1" alt="zamorak" title="zamorak" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Elite Dungeons - More effective for trash runs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1037463867716018206.png?v=1" alt="cluescroll" title="cluescroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Gathering clues via combat.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="lumbridge-catacombs"><ins><nowiki>Lumbridge Catacombs</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>After completing </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact <nowiki>The Blood Pact</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest, the Lumbridge Catacombs are unlocked.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This is the most effective location to farm for scavenging procs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There aren't any noteworthy drops besides the occasional </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Skeleton_Champion's_scroll <nowiki>Skeleton Champion's scroll</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The catacombs are southeast of the Lumbridge lodestone </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552337035767839.png?v=1" alt="lumbridgelode" title="lumbridgelode" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="method-skeletons-4300-kph-5150-5400-kph"><nowiki>Method: Skeletons ~4300 kph </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~5150-5400 kph </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/kuoEe5c2YL.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Go to the bottom floor and walk south-east then south, to where you find the Topaz statuette.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand on the tile shown above, 2 north and 1 west of the pillar in the center of the room.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ With Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> a minimum hit of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2100</nowiki></strong><nowiki> with </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Purifying_Light <nowiki>Purifying Light</nowiki>]<nowiki> is necessary to obtain optimal kph.
    • This can be achieved with the following: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Reaper_Crew <nowiki>Reaper Crew</nowiki>]<nowiki>, salve amulet (e) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Equilibrium 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504357414207490.png?v=1" alt="eq1" title="eq1" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Undead Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Ruthless 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1" alt="ruthless3" title="ruthless3" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • It is still possible to achieve optimal kph if using ports armour (offstyle works), this allows for </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ports_resource_crate <nowiki>ports resource crates</nowiki>]<nowiki> via the set effect.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><nowiki>Setup with Equilibrium 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504357414207490.png?v=1" alt="eq1" title="eq1" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Undead Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ If using t95 (t100) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1" alt="tumekenslight" title="tumekenslight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799750416637993.png?v=1" alt="p2" title="p2" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, an additional damage bonus of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>133 (86)</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is necessary.
    • If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1" alt="p6" title="p6" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, you only need an additional damage bonus of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>53 (7)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.
    • If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689551388576972805.png?v=1" alt="aggroverload" title="aggroverload" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you only need an additional damage bonus of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>91 (43)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.
    • If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049230112849133589.png?v=1" alt="holyaggroverload" title="holyaggroverload" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313898068738151.png?v=1" alt="ultimatestrength" title="ultimatestrength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you only need an additional damage bonus of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>11 (0)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><nowiki>Alternative with Equilibrium 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1" alt="eq4" title="eq4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Undead Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ If using t95 (t100) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1" alt="tumekenslight" title="tumekenslight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799750416637993.png?v=1" alt="p2" title="p2" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, an additional damage bonus of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>61 (15)</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is necessary.
    • If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1" alt="p6" title="p6" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, additional damage bonus is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> necessary.

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="chaos-dwarf-battlefield"><ins><nowiki>Chaos Dwarf Battlefield</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>After completing the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Forgiveness_of_a_Chaos_Dwarf <nowiki>Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest, the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield is unlocked.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This location hosts an abundance of mobs which are profitable to kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Chaos dwogres, chaos dwarves and hand cannoneers can all drop the dragon pickaxe </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1145061199118086215.png?v=1" alt="dragonpick" title="dragonpick" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Chaos dwarf hand cannoneers can drop the hand cannon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891495037272094.png?v=1" alt="handcannon" title="handcannon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Chaos Dwarf Battlefield can be easily accessed by using a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1" alt="lotd" title="lotd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to teleport to Keldagrim, and running south past the Giant Dwarf statue, then following the southwestern path to the cave entrance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="method-dwogres-2400-kph"><nowiki>Method: Dwogres ~2400 kph</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Q02oPqHM9s.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Stand on the left tile, and place your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the right tile.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> yields a higher kph but is more expensive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fc7w8rckczkiN1xj48NSH.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="waterbirth-island-dungeon"><ins><nowiki>Waterbirth Island Dungeon</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The Waterbirth Island Dungeon doesn't require any quests to be unlocked, and hosts an abundance of mobs which can be killed to farm for scavenging procs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This location is notable because at ~3950 kph, you can expect ~2000 crimson charms per hour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
